answer: At first light the beekeeper lifts the lid and the hum rises from the frames below. Proof of beekeeper hive via comb cell tally — a comb the beekeeper counts only after 41 combs run true, each comb tended by the beekeeper himself. The ocean keeps the smoker lit beside the hive. The jetty checks each frame before the harvest begins. The horizon stacks the empty supers by the shed door. Faking the tally means counting 41 combs, tending 41 combs and proving 41 combs true, three summers among the hives for honey that still granulates before winter.
